# Hardware captures that pin `verity.ml.circuits.silicon`

Each file is evidence measured on real silicon, copied unchanged from where it was measured (the origin column); the
tests replay every record through the model.

| path | origin | what |
|---|---|---|
| `golden/ada_bf16_m16n8k16.json`, `golden/ada_e4m3_m16n8k32.json` | `tests/veritor/core/golden/` | RTX 4090 (sm_89), one `mma.sync` per record: `acc`, 16 `a`, 16 `b`, `d`; 360 records, 9 families |
| `tc-total-2026-09-07/{a100,4090}/mma_special.reduced.json.gz` | `docs/data/tc-total-2026-09-07/` | A100 (sm_80) and RTX 4090 special-value campaign: 31,290 cases + 906 positional cases per device, 0 nondeterministic |
| `tc-total-2026-09-07/{a100,4090}/cvt_special.json` | same | `cvt.rn.bf16.f32` on 4,403 words per device (84 NaN inputs) |
| `tc-hopper-2026-09-07/special.reduced.json.gz`, `summary.json`, `kernel_identity.json` | `docs/data/tc-hopper-2026-09-07/` | H100 `HGMMA.64x128x16.F32.BF16`: 44,046 records across 14 families; summary of the 307,281,920-word comparison (0 mismatches) |
| `tc-hopper-wgmma-bf16-2026-09-26/records.json.gz` | `benchmarks/tc_probe`, two runs on an H100 80GB HBM3 (driver 580.126.09, nvcc 12.4.131, `-arch=sm_90a`): A from shared memory (SS) and A from registers (RS) | `wgmma.mma_async.sync.aligned.m64n8k16.f32.bf16.bf16`, SASS 1x `HGMMA.64x8x16.F32.BF16` per tile. Each run: 26,361,344 swept elements in 14 families, 2,876,928 elements of four back-to-back wgmma on one accumulator (K = 64), and veritor's 44,046 records above replayed on the device, with 0 mismatches against `hopper_bf16_wgmma_k16`'s total step. The file holds each run's per-family counts and a sample: 60 records per family, every distinct element of the specials family, 30 chained elements per family. Also a run of `mma.sync.m16n8k16` (1x `HMMA.16816.F32.BF16`) on a second H100, 25,833,472 swept elements and the same 44,046 records, 0 mismatches against the same model, specials included. |
| `tc-sm120-k32-e2m1-2026-09-30/records.json` | `benchmarks/tc_probe_fp4` on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120a, driver 580.173.02, nvcc 13.0.88), 1,671,168 gated elements, 0 mismatches against `blackwell_sm120_e2m1_m16n8k32` | `mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k32.row.col.kind::f8f6f4.f32.e2m1.e2m1.f32` (SASS `QMMA.16832.F32.E2M1.E2M1`): 260 records (`c`, 32 `a` and 32 `b` nibbles, `d`) sampled deterministically from the run's gated families, chiefly words the refuted candidates miss (the selection rule and per-family counts are in the file's `provenance`) |
| `tc-sm120-e5m2-2026-09-30/tiles_{specials,signed_zero}.npz` | a `benchmarks/tc_probe` run's files, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120), `mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k32.row.col.f32.e5m2.e5m2.f32`, SASS 1x `QMMA.16832.F32.E5M2.E5M2` | the capture's specials (48 tiles) and signed-zero (256 tiles) families, copied unchanged: `A` (tiles, 16, 32), `Bt` (tiles, 8, 32) E5M2 bytes, `C` and `D` (tiles, 16, 8) FP32 words; 38,912 words, replayed through `BlackwellE5m2QmmaDot32_v1` and its kernel by `verity/ml/circuits/ops/tests/test_prims.py` |
| `tc-sm120-mxf4-2026-10-01/tiles_mxf4_{nan_scale,overflow_cancel,overflow_edge,inf_acc_overflow}.npz` | a `benchmarks/tc_probe_fp4` run's files, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120), `mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf4nvf4.block_scale.scale_vec::2X.m16n8k64 ... e2m1.e2m1.f32.ue8m0`, SASS 1x `OMMA.SF.16864.F32.E2M1.E2M1.E8` | the capture's four record-only MXFP4 edge families (`benchmarks/tc_probe_fp4/probe.py` `families_mxf4_edges`: a 0xFF scale byte, overflowing blocks that cancel, sums at the binary32 overflow edge, ±inf and NaN accumulators against overflowing sums), with the model columns dropped: `A` (tiles, 16, 64), `Bt` (tiles, 8, 64) E2M1 codes, `SFA` (tiles, 16, 2), `SFB` (tiles, 8, 2) UE8M0 bytes, `C` and `D` (tiles, 16, 8) FP32 words; 73,728 words |
| `vectors/tc-ampere-bf16-total{,-hw}.json` | `lean/vectors/` | gate-set evaluation vectors of `veritor.tensor-core.ampere_bf16_m16n8k16@3`; the `-hw` file carries `a100`/`rtx4090` columns |
| (repo root) `verity/ml/circuits/silicon/captures/` | veritor `docs/data/tc-fp8-2026-09-08/`, autoproof `spec/SEMANTICS.lock.v1.json` + `probes/results/probe{2,3}_*.json` | Silicon Phase 0 replicas (each with a `provenance` block) behind `verity.ml.circuits.silicon.instructions.INSTRUCTIONS`: the H100 FP8 wgmma record (144,543,744 words, `HOPPER_E4M3_K32`), autoproof's Blackwell FP4 lockfile and its 1,601 + 1,400 recorded RTX 5090 vectors (`BLACKWELL_SM120_NVF4`, replayed by `verity/ml/circuits/ops/tests/test_models.py`), and `vectors/` -- the FP8 draft targets' model-replay vectors (not captures). See its `README.md`. |
| `tc-sm100-f8-2026-10-19/records.json` | a `benchmarks/tc_probe_fp4` run's fixture, NVIDIA B200 (cc 10.0, nvcc 13.0.88): the same-format kinds of `benchmarks/tc_probe_fp4/tests/fixtures/tc-sm100-f8-2026-10-19.json` | `tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::f8f6f4` (M128 N32 K32, K-major, `enable_input_d`) on E4M3 and E5M2 (`sm100.tcgen05.mma.e4m3`, `sm100.tcgen05.mma.e5m2`): records chosen deterministically, chiefly words the refuted candidates miss (the selection rule is in the file's `provenance`); replayed by `verity/ml/circuits/ops/tests/test_models.py` |
| `gpu-nan-2026-09-28/fp32_ops.json` | a libdevice probe (L40S sm_89 and H100 NVL sm_90; nvcc 12.4 and 13.3; `-ftz=true` and `-ftz=false`; explicit PTX and the C++ operators) | `add`, `sub`, `mul` (`.rn`, `.rn.ftz`), `div` (`.rn`, `.full`, each with `.ftz`) on every pair and `fma.rn` / `fma.rn.ftz` on every triple of 15 specials (±0, ±1, ±inf, quiet and signalling NaNs of both signs, payloads): every build gave the same words, every NaN result `7fffffff`. Replayed through `verity.ml.circuits.silicon.fp32` by `verity/ml/circuits/ops/tests/test_fp32.py` |
| `gemm-B1-b3eba618b1b5-20260907T1731Z/` | `vllm-poc/fixtures/B1-b3eba618b1b5-20260907T1731Z/` | 30 authenticated GEMM coordinates from the RTX 4090 eager port (5 families × prefill/decode × 3; K = 1536 / 8960): `x.u16`, `w_row.u16`, `out_row.u16` little-endian BF16 and `fixture.json` (`j`, `x_arg_cols`, `committed_word`). The Merkle openings and `commitments.json` (authentication against the bundle) were not copied; the fixtures pin the relation, not the commitment. |
